visual.description: Primary white background used across most page sections.
Deep navy used for primary headings and the Stripe logo.
Dark slate used for body copy and secondary text.
Stripe's signature indigo-purple used for primary CTA buttons and links.
Deep blue used for the 'Contact sales' CTA button.
Very light blue-gray used as card and section surface backgrounds.
Light gray used for dividers and card borders.
Medium gray used for captions, stat labels, and secondary descriptive text.
Deep indigo background used in the 'backbone of global commerce' full-width dark section.
Mid-range indigo used for stat numbers and decorative UI elements in the dark section.
Warm amber/orange used for the Stripe wordmark and 'Sign in' button border.
Soft pink gradient tone prominent in the hero section's colorful background illustration.
Warm orange tone from the hero and product section gradient backgrounds.
Light purple/lavender used in gradient backgrounds and card decorative elements.
Bright green used for 'Succeeded' payment status badges.
Red used for 'Disputed' payment status badges.
